well the terrors of injury.
I persuade her 
that rushing now will render all her past 
patience meaningless.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. Maybe I was getting a 
little ahead of myself...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, no need to rush, take it easy. 
Healing the injury comes first!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I will get some rest and focus on 
recovering.

usual!

Sakura Laurel started with light training 
at the gym, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry. The pain is...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'll give up on training. ...I felt it 
firsthand.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I can't push myself any further than
this. 
I'll rest for a while.

With her injury worsening, Sakura Laurel 
rested quietly and focused on recovering.

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —Yeah. At this pace, I'll be fine...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—I feel no pain. I think I can keep going 
a bit longer!

Sakura Laurel continued training within 
reasonable limits, keeping her injury in 
mind.
